```{r}
#|echo: false
#|warning: false

# read in required packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(forcats)
library(scales)

mat_neo_data <- read_excel(here("data/MatNeoSIP.xlsx"), sheet = "Data") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(
    "stage_7_all" = "stage_7",
    "quarter" = "date"
  ) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., "x", "stage_"), starts_with("x"))
```

```{r}
# functions

# 1 aggregate
aggregate_int <- function(df, my_filter, intervention) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  df |>
    filter(!!my_filter) |>
    group_by(
      psc,
      !!intervention
    ) |>
    summarise(n = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(psc) |>
    mutate(
      total = sum(n),
      percentage = round((n / total) * 100, 1)
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

# 2 make graph
visualise <- function(df, intervention, intervention_name = NULL) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  # this is to set the subtitle string
  if (is.null(intervention_name)) {
    intervention_string <- deparse(intervention)

    intervention_subtitle <- str_to_title( # 3 capitalise clean string into title
      str_replace_all( # 2 replace _ with blank space
        str_remove(intervention_string, "~"), # 1 remove ~ added by deparse
        "_", " "
      )
    )
  } else {
    intervention_subtitle <- intervention_name
  }


  # custom palette of blues in reversed order
  blues <- rev(scales::brewer_pal()(7))
  text_colour <- c(rep("white", 3), rep("black", 4))

  # crate a NULL parameter for subtitle

  df |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = forcats::fct_rev(psc), # reverse alphabetical order
      y = percentage,
      fill = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) # reverse stage order
    )) +
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      position = "stack",
      size = 11
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = blues, na.value = "#808080") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = text_colour, na.value = "white") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.025, 0.025)) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = paste0(
          round(percentage), # rounding to no decimal places here
          "%"
        ), # so bars stack to 100 or as close as possible
        colour = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) # reverse again so position argument is obeyed
      ),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_none()) +
    labs(
      title = "Adoption of optimisation internventions across PCS's as a share of implementation stages",
      subtitle = intervention_subtitle,
      caption = glue::glue("Data reported by the PSC's for {report_quarter}")
    ) +
    # guide_legend(reverse = T) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "left",
      plot.caption = element_text(
        face = "italic",
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0 # so caption is on right hand side
      )
    )
}
```

## title slide

```{r}
report_quarter <- "2024/25 Q1"
# mat_neo_agg |> select(psc:quarter, intervention, stage)
mat_neo_long <- mat_neo_data |>
  filter(quarter == report_quarter) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = magnesium_sulphate:mews,
    names_to = "intervention",
    values_to = "stage"
  )

visualise(
  aggregate_int(
    mat_neo_long,
    my_filter = expr(!intervention %in% c(
      "mews", "newtt2", # excluded because they're not optimisation interventions
      "volume_targeted_ventilation", # why has this been excluded?
      "caffeine" # ditto
    )),
    stage
  ),
  stage,
  "All optimisation interventions (Excl. caffeine and volume targeted ventilation)"
)
```

# Line chart slide 12

```{r}
mat_neo_agg_stage5_provider <- mat_neo_data |>
  select(psc:volume_targeted_ventilation) |>
  mutate(
    all_stages = paste(magnesium_sulphate,
      corticosteroids,
      antibiotics,
      optimal_cord_management,
      normothermia,
      maternal_breast_milk,
      place_of_birth,
      caffeine,
      volume_targeted_ventilation,
      sep = "_"
    ), # will paste NA as string 'NA' and this is intentional for counts
    stage_5_or_above = str_count(all_stages, "Stage (5|6|7)"),
    stage_5_all = if_else(stage_5_or_above >= 7, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  select(-all_stages)

bar_all <- mat_neo_agg_stage5_provider |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  summarise(
    s5_all = sum(stage_5_all),
    all_reporters = n(),
    percentage = (s5_all / all_reporters)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

bar_all |> head()
```

```{r}
bar_all |>
  ggplot(aes(x = quarter,
             y = percentage,
             group = 1)
         ) +
  geom_line(colour = '#660066'
            ) +
  geom_point(colour = '#660066',
             size = 2
             ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.65,
             linetype = 'dashed',
             colour = 'navy'
             ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = '2021/22 Q3', y = 0.70, label = 'Target for 2022/23 Q4 (i.e., 65%)') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)
    )

```

```{r}
#turn below into a function and then rbind then make spaghetti chart
my_function <- function(df, intervention) {
  
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)
  
  #to quote intervention name
 intervention_string <- deparse(intervention)

  intervention_name <- str_to_title( # 3 capitalise clean string into title
    str_replace_all( # 2 replace _ with blank space
      str_remove(intervention_string, "~"), # 1 remove ~ added by deparse
      "_", " "
    )
  )
  
  df |>
    select(psc:quarter, !!intervention) |>
    mutate(
      stage_5_or_above = str_count(!!intervention, "Stage (5|6|7)"),
      stage_5_all = if_else(stage_5_or_above >= 1, 1, 0)
      ) |> 
    group_by(quarter) |>
    summarise(
      s5_all = sum(stage_5_all, na.rm = T),
      all_reporters = n(),
      percentage = (s5_all / all_reporters)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(intervention = intervention_name,
           .after = quarter
          )
}
```

```{r}
spaghetti_data <- bind_rows(
  my_function(mat_neo_data, magnesium_sulphate),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, corticosteroids),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, antibiotics),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, optimal_cord_management),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, normothermia),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, maternal_breast_milk),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, place_of_birth),
  my_function(mat_neo_data, caffeine), #not included in orignal chart, why?
  my_function(mat_neo_data, volume_targeted_ventilation) #ditto
  )

spaghetti_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = quarter,
             y = percentage,
             group = intervention,
             colour = intervention
             )

  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'bottom'
    )
```
